svg.title: From theorem to assessment
svg.desc: Four steps: distil a proposal to a POMDP, identify which of the six structural properties are present, assess whether the decision-maker possesses the matching primitives, then declare the outcome. If all required primitives are possessed the proposal avoids guaranteed linear regret; if any is lacking it suffers linear regret.
